title: Typhoon Domeng (Jangmi) exiting PAR June 1 — 120kph, enhancing habagat, 832,986 affected
snippet: Typhoon Domeng exits PAR June 1. 670km east of Basco, Batanes. 120kph sustained, 150kph gusts, NNW at 20kph. Enhancing southwest monsoon — moderate to heavy rainfall Luzon/Visayas next 4 days. Total 832,986 people affected across Catanduanes, Albay, Camarines Sur. Flooding and landslides in Mayon ashfall areas.
tag_reason: PAR exit June 1, enhanced habagat rains, 832,986 total affected — cross-domain with Mayon ashfall area flooding
